subject: [PATCH v4 4/4] btrfs: pre-allocate delayed dir index for non-overwrite rename

2026-08-25.patch_summary: This patch adds a feature to the Btrfs file system that allows it to pre-allocate delayed directory index resources before making any btree modifications during a rename operation. This is done by introducing a new function, `btrfs_prealloc_delayed_dir_index`, which is called in the non-overwrite case of the `btrfs_rename` function. The patch also adds a new parameter to the `btrfs_add_link` function that allows callers to pass pre-allocated delayed directory index resources. This change aims to prevent ENOMEM errors from occurring after btree state has changed, by returning -ENOMEM early if the pre-allocation fails.
